comment: Gate R mutual pinning — the peer artifact this release is measured against. The main record (data-v1.3.manifest.json) stays byte-identical to the published asset; peers are recorded here.

vdocs-data:data-v1.relation: vdocs data-v1 is the peer this release's entity bridge is built from. vdocs measured its entity-quality floors against vista-meta data-v1, not data-v1.3. data-v1.3 is a re-extraction under schema_version 1 from the same pinned image as data-v1.2 (VistA-VEHU-M 62622e63); it differs from data-v1.2 only in routine-calls and the tables derived from it, now that the call extractor reads every argument of a DO/GOTO/JOB.
